integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof and independently rerun symbolic/225 matrix comparisons; no independent validation or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional symmetric three-mode diffusion/ballistic process; constant strictly positive transition/reset/diffusion/speed parameters; full-state Poisson reset to origin; ideal stationary observables, known other parameters. Stationary position coincidence does not entail phase-position or temporal law coincidence. No finite-data efficiency, robustness, non-Poisson, target or nonlinear extensions proved. The source paper already contains the general renewal/Fourier resolvent from which the stationary part is algebraically derivable. Mathematical priority has residual uninspected-literature uncertainty.
title: Exact stationary cloaking and one-lag recovery in an intermittent resetting walk
